claims.claim: 741-741 is the texting version of 911 for counseling.
Dialing 933 provides your exact location in buildings.
VHF channel 16 is the distress frequency at sea.
112 is the global emergency number outside the Americas.
Railroad ID numbers are crucial when stranded on tracks.
